priorityList: Ensure Hunter's Mark is active on the target.
Cast Wildfire Bomb if you are about to cap at 2 charges
Cast Kill Command if you have 2 charges or to avoid capping Focus
Cast Fury of the Eagle if you have 3 stacks of Tip of the Spear
Cast Butchery to spend Tip of the Spear stacks
Cast Flanking Strike to generate Focus and Tip of the Spear
Cast Kill Command to generate Tip of the Spear and Focus
